title: The Text section's Font, Size and Weight menus look like every other dropdown in the panel
goal: With a title picked on a video, the panel shows two kinds of dropdown one above the other: the Time section's Fade In and Fade Out are the panel's drawn dropdowns with a chevron, full width, while the Text section's Font, Size and Weight are small system pop-up buttons with up and down arrows and a narrower box. It reads as two apps stitched together. Make the text menus the same dropdown the rest of the panel uses, keeping what they do today.
notes: Manager pass 2026-10-05, UI quality lens. Seen in /tmp/photonz-playtest/an-editing-session-walk/6-title-at-b-sc.png (copied to queue/manager/shots/2026-10-05-0245-app-dissolve.png for the panel at a cut): Font 'Georgia ⇕', Size '80 px ⇕', Weight 'Bold ⇕' against Fade In 'None ⌄'. Code: InspectorControls.swift:445-520 SelectionMenu is a SwiftUI Picker .pickerStyle(.menu) (a system pop-up). The rest of the video panel uses VideoKit.Dropdown (VideoKitControls.swift, an AppKit pull-down holding the drawn SelectFace, from every-dropdown-in-the-panel-opens-when-you-click, audit 2026-09-29-every-dropdown-opens-on-a-click.json). Callers: TextInspector.swift:74-105, CaptionsInspector.swift:323. Keep SelectionMenu's Equatable short-circuit (picking-or-retyping-a-caption-answers-at-once) and its MenuTip help. This is shared code, so Current gets it too; check Current's text panel still reads right.
acceptance: Font, Size and Weight in the Text section (and the caption Font row, which uses the same control) are drawn with the panel's dropdown face, the same height, chevron, fill and label placement as Fade In, in light and dark
Mixed still reads Mixed in the dimmed style, a long font name is still cut with an ellipsis and spelled in full on hover, and the Size box still holds one width whatever size is picked
Picking from each still changes the text in one undo step, and the existing type menu tests and walks pass
The dropdown click walks cover the three menus (clicked at the middle and near each end), so a dead click target cannot come back
Side by side picture of the Text and Time sections before and after, light and dark, in the audit
Works at Next defaults with no switch turned on, and an audit written under queue/audits/ gives the try steps and a real picture
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Adversarial pass before building: (1) the fix is to draw SelectionMenu with VideoKit.Dropdown, so the three menus become full-width drawn faces exactly like Fade In; the box no longer sizes from its list, so the figure-space padding and the pinned Font width stop being needed. (2) Mixed: the drawn face has no Mixed row trick, so the face itself wears Mixed in MixedLook.style and the open menu ticks nothing (Photoshop shows a blank, the app has always said Mixed). (3) Clipping: the old test measured an NSPopUpButton; a drawn face needs its own measure against the width it is actually given, or the hover stops leading with a shortened font name. (4) A SwiftUI .help may not reach an AppKit button inside a representable, so the dropdown carries its own toolTip. (5) Shared code: Current's Text section gets the same face; Size and Weight keep their two columns there. The text tool's own popover (EditorView fontMenu pickers) is a different surface and is left alone.
owns these walks: every-title-dropdown-opens-on-a-click-walk, type-menu-labels-walk, menu-says-its-whole-value-walk, size-menu-one-width-walk, font-menu-one-width-walk, mixed-one-look-walk

Built: SelectionMenu (InspectorControls.swift) now draws VideoKit.Dropdown; SelectFace/Dropdown gained valueStyle (Mixed in MixedLook.style) and help (button toolTip, since .help does not reach the AppKit button); SelectFace.fits replaces MenuMetrics (deleted) for the clipped-name tip, measured against the width the face actually gets (onGeometryChange). Size titles use sizeWords now: the figure-space padding only existed to hold a pop-up's width. Gotcha: the face's HStack puts 8pt on BOTH sides of the Spacer, so the room is width - 2*pad - 16 - chevron; counting 8 made the Bodoni hover walk fail.

Verified: type-menu-labels, size-menu-one-width, font-menu-one-width, menu-says-its-whole-value, mixed-one-look, label-size, label-weight, captions-are-one-layer, a-title-reads-over-a-video, one-unit-word, text-style walks all ok. every-title-dropdown-opens-on-a-click-walk now clicks Font, Size and Weight at centre/start/end and photographs Time+Text in dark and light; EveryDropdownIsClickedByAWalkTests registers the three names. Current layout checked with next-panel-rows-in-one-column off (a /tmp copy of type-menu-labels): Size and Weight share their row evenly. Scripts/test.sh 11367 tests green.
